offer.question: Can't follow a moving dot?
offer.note: The sound version is an alternative for people who can't follow a moving dot. Like the dot version, it hasn't been tested itself; the lab research used eye movements.

how_it_works.heading: How the sound game works
how_it_works.text: You'll hear a short tone every second or two. Most tones are low. When you hear a high tone, respond as quickly as you can.
how_it_works.keyboard: Keyboard: press Space. The game area takes focus by itself.
how_it_works.pointer: Mouse, touch or screen reader: use the “High tone” button.
how_it_works.sound_check: Turn your sound on first; headphones help. Listen to both tones:
how_it_works.game_label: Sound game: press Space, or the High tone button, each time you hear a high tone. {seconds} seconds left.

round.image: Listen for the high tones, and keep your picture in mind: “{picture}”.
